svg.title: Colón Quest
svg.desc: A financial-literacy game for Costa Rican students. Each month the player decides what to do with their money, Muse Wonder narrates the consequence, a deterministic engine computes the exact colones, and the player negotiates by voice with characters who hide fees. The AI tells the story; the finance engine keeps the books.
svg.text: Every money decision becomes a story.
The AI tells the story. The finance engine keeps the books.
